description: Archipelago implementation for LET IT DIE Offline Edition.

V1.1.description:
## LET IT DIE Archipelago - V1.1

## Changes in V1.1

- Pop-up messages are added to indicate the sending of checks as well as the receipt of items.

## Checks/Locations
- **ChestSanity** added as a check for red, silver, and gold chests, the values in the YAML correspond to the number of chests requested for each set of 10 floors.
- **MaterialSanity** added as checks the 6 plan upgrade materials as well as faction metals, the values in the YAML indicate the number of materials that must be collected for each type of material and metal.

## Filler 
- **KC** added Kill Coins as filler 2,000, 10,000, and 50,000 KC, each with a percentage adjustable in the YAML

### Link to the apworld and YAML source code https://github.com/Neo-Prod/Let-it-Die-Archipelago/tree/releaseV1.1
